name: On Task Complete
description: Moves completed task files and updates DEV_STATE.md

then.prompt:
A task file in tasks/ was edited. If this task is now complete:
1. Move the task file to tasks/completed/ (or tasks/_completed/)
2. Update DEV_STATE.md — set today's date, update service statuses, record evidence of completion (test output, sessionId, promiseId, or diff summary)
3. If all tasks for a package are complete, update that package's README.md
4. Check if the empty queue policy applies: prune completed items, discover new work, write new tasks if needed
Only act if the task content indicates completion.
